cs_enter: Bigby exits the elevator into freewalk.  Beauty and Beast can be heard arguing from inside their apartment.
use_door: Bigby knocks and either Beauty or Beast will answer the door.  For these next few blocking positions B and B will be interchangeable.
cs_beautyAtDoor/beastAtDoor: Beauty answers the door, but does not let Bigby in at first.
cs_bigbyIntoApt: Bigby enters the foyer, and Beauty walks away into the main room.  Free walk is enabled.
Bigby can now freewalk toward the main room.
use_OilPainting: Bigby paths to the painting and comments.
use_OrnateUrns: Bigby paths to the urn and comments.
use_Chandelier: Bigby checks out the sweet chandelier.
Bigby can use 3 clickables in the main room.
cs_bigbyArrives: Bigby walks over to the bickering couple.
cs_bigbyArrives (I gotta say): Bigby begins to get a little judgey.
cs_bigbyArrives (post): When Bigby mentions the Crooked Man, Beauty and Beast sit down.
cs_Resistance: Beauty and Beast debate on what to tell Bigby.
cs_fear (phone rings): By the time the phone starts to ring, Bigby has placed himself between BnB and the phone (which will be on the left wall.
cs_fear (Beauty goes to answer): Beauty panics and moves to stop the answering machine.
useBeauty/Beast: Bigby stops Beauty from answering.  The message plays out.
cs_Message (Message ends): By the end of the first choice dialog, B or B has returned to their seat.  Branch this dialog interaction to have a Beauty and a Beast version.
cs_recap: B n B are on the couch, finally ready to tell Bigby the truth.
cs_beautyTalk/cs_beastTalks: We may need blocking changes during their confessions to keep the scene interesting.
cs_bigbyJudgement: And they both need to be back on the couch for the start of this exchange, as well.
cs_beautyTalk/cs_beastTalks: However, both B n B need to be back on the couch for the start of the other person's confession.
cs_insultBigby: Beauty rises to her feet.
cs_BigbyGamePlans: Beast rises to comfort Beauty.
cs_TheDecision: For the choice moment, Bigby can stay in a similar spot, but we'll cheat him around to get the most interesting bg for the choice cam.
cs_TheDecision (PartingShot): Bigby starts to leave and Beast asks if he'll "help them out."
cs_TheDecision: Bigby turns back for his response and then leaves.
